name: Inverse Rendering with Differential Trackers
definition: An unbiased method for estimating gradients with respect to the parameters of scattering volumes (density $σ_t$, albedo $α$) to minimize a re-rendering objective function in inverse rendering.
summary: Inverse Rendering with Differential Trackers is an unbiased method for estimating gradients in volume rendering that uses differential ratio tracking to avoid separate control density hyperparameters and reduce computation cost.
